messages.author: 0374541533837d46
messages.subject: RApache encoding problem
parts:
Hi,

I'm using RApache 1.1.17 under Mac osx 10.6.8

I have encoding problems with the R print function.
I tried to use the SERVER$content_encoding variable with no success.

Here a simple example:
header="<meta http-equiv='Content-Type' content='text/html;
charset=UTF-8'>"
cat(header)
cat('<HTML><head></head>')
cat('<body>')
cat('<p>')
print("été")
cat('</p>')
cat('</body></html>')

->web page output: \303\251t\303\251
->the output is the good one when i use the "cat" function instead of
the "print" one.

Thank you.

Jérôme

messages.author: 98e634f62928ae87
messages.subject: Re: RApache encoding problem
parts:
Dear Jérôme,

try to set your `locale` before `print`ing to UTF-8.

E.g.:

Sys.setlocale("LC_ALL", "en_US.utf8")

Best,
Gergely
